hero.title: Security and compliance, built in from day one
hero.summary: True Aim is certified to ISO 27001. The SOC 2 Type II audit window is complete and the report is pending. Its controls are aligned with the GDPR, the Swiss FADP and DORA. Every claims decision is recorded with the facts, the rules and the reasoning behind it, so the record stands up to audit, regulatory review and dispute.

humanInLoop.heading: A person stays in the loop
humanInLoop.p1: By default, True Aim prepares a recommendation for a person to confirm. Full automation runs only where you and your regulator allow it.
humanInLoop.p2: Every decision is recorded with its clause, its evidence and its author, so an auditor's or a regulator's question is answered from the record alone.

items.question: Which certifications does True Aim hold?
items.answer: True Aim is certified to ISO/IEC 27001:2022 by A-LIGN (September 2026). The SOC 2 Type II audit window closed on 31 July 2026 and the report is pending. Its controls are aligned with the GDPR, the Swiss FADP and DORA.

items.question: Does True Aim decide claims without a person?
items.answer: Not by default. True Aim prepares a recommendation with the facts, the rules and the reasoning, and a person confirms it. Full automation runs only for the claim types where you and your regulator allow it.

items.question: Can a decision be checked after the fact?
items.answer: Yes. Every decision is recorded with its inputs, the rules that applied and the source document behind each figure, and any decision can be run again with the same result.
